snippet.title: The Warmth Between Us Trailer
snippet.description:
It is late December in Taipei, the pavement glows like silver under the bone-chilling winter rain.

With the New Year drawing close, we met for the first time. Our rendezvous.

There was nothing special about our beginning. It was ordinary, yet, so unaccounted for.

However, I could not help but let myself drown in this warm but distant vibe.

Her shadows, her every move and sensation piques my curiosity.
The warmth between us has a certain comfort which I've never felt before…...

This is a story about the warmth between people.

It was a simple act that brought us together, but became a life-defining moment affecting the choices we make.

Our relationship cannot be described as merely friendship or love. It is instead built upon the support and warmth we share with each other.

It is….. A simple act of intuition.
